correctness.rationale: For n>=5, the normalized iid exponential gap representation reduces each moment to local integrals with at most five independent exponentials. Critical integrals E[J0 J2 X2]=11/225 and E[J0 X0 J2 X2]=22/1125, checked independently by exact chamber sums, yield Cov(M,W)=16/675 and Var(W)=44/[1125(n+1)]. The same representation independently yields Cov(M,L)=-1/36; decomposition gives nonreciprocal sign. Var(M)=2n/45 and Var(L)=1/[6(n+1)] verify correlation formulas. Exact rational rank enumeration for n=5..8 validates finite cases but is not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Compared complete accessible key sections of Wade arXiv:math/0603559 (weighted length first-order LLNs) and Bahadir/Ceyhan arXiv:1605.01940 (unweighted mutual pair count), plus an accessible earlier finding on M against radius-isolated vertices. The latter DOES imply Cov(M,L) by integration and is therefore not treated as new. None of these implication statements supplies Cov(M,W), Var(W), or its persistent positive correlation. Searches produced no exact coverage, with an inaccessible but plausible 1999 source retained as residual risk.
residual_risks: Enns–Ehlers–Misi 1999 is a directly relevant primary enumeration but only abstract and bibliography were accessible through lawful public and institutional routes; equivalent weighted moment identities implicit there cannot be excluded.

Mathematical literature indexes and available prior statements are not exhaustive, and unchecked historical content cannot establish originality.

value.rationale: Mutual NN pairs are the two-cycle components in the directed graph, and their edge lengths contribute twice to the directed length. Exact Cov(M,W)>0 while Cov(M,L)<0 and Cov(M,U)<0 reveals opposing persistent geometric mechanisms; the positive and negative correlations have explicit nonzero asymptotic limits. The new finite-n weighted reciprocal-pair variance and covariance are motivated by a standard graph-length decomposition, not an arbitrary parameter slice or computational lookup.
